description: Cogitate (2025): the preregistered pairwise phase consistency analysis found no content-selective synchrony between face- or object-selective electrodes and prefrontal electrodes in the relevant window.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered. Phase estimation from macroscopic recordings is noisy.

sources.quote: No content-selective PPC was found between face-selective and object-selective electrodes and PFC electrodes in the relevant time window, contradicting the prediction of GNWT
